name: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd.
summary: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, and sells food products in Japan. It operates through Food, Feedstuff and Others segments. The company offers wheat flour for bread, cakes, noodles, and other products; premixes, and pastas. It provides vegetable oils including cooking oil, and soy protein. The company also offers saccharified products, cornstarch, and modified starch. In addition, it provides compound feed for poultry, pigs, cattle, and fish. Further, the company provides warehousing services for storing and handling imported grain; and leases of owned real estate properties.
